'''Killi Gimm''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] member of the [[Disciples of the Whills]], a religious group that congregated around the [[Temple of the Kyber]] in [[Jedha City]] on the [[moon]] [[Jedha]]. She ran an [[Gimm sisters' orphanage|orphanage]] with her sister [[Kaya Gimm|Kaya]]. [[Gender|She]] suffered from breathing problems, forcing her to wear a [[Breath mask|mask]] and air filter. Gimm was present in the [[city]] in the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]] shortly before its [[Destruction of Jedha City|destruction]] by the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|That is the problem. For as long as the Empire remains here, we are trapped in this cycle.|Killi Gimm to Baze Malbus and Chirrut Îmwe|<ref name="GotW" />}}
A [[human]] [[Gender|female]], Killi Gimm was a member of [[the Force]] religion the [[Disciples of the Whills]] and lived in the [[Jedha City|Holy City]] on [[Jedha]] and was considered to be one the eldest of the order. During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], Jedha was occupied by [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] in order to [[Mining|mine]] [[kyber crystal]]s for use in the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star's]] [[superlaser]]. Citizens began to [[Death|die]] in great numbers in the mines and during attacks from insurgent groups attempting to drive out the Empire. These deaths lead to a large number of orphans within Jedha [[City]]. Gimm persuaded her younger sister, [[Kaya Gimm]], to turn her home and droid repair shop into an [[Gimm sisters' orphanage|orphanage]].<ref name="GotW" />

Gimm became friends with [[Chirrut Îmwe]] and [[Baze Malbus]], who shared in her religion as [[Guardians of the Whills]]. Îmwe and Malbus helped the Gimm sisters maintain the orphanage by stealing supplies from the Empire. The Empire retaliated, destroying Kaya's home and forcing the Gimm sisters and their charges to flee. Malbus found an abandoned home for the two sisters to move into along with their orphans. A few [[Standard month|months]] later, it soon became clear that Jedha was no longer safe for the orphans and Gimm sisters. With the help of [[Saw Gerrera]] and his [[Partisans]], Îmwe and Malbus were able to steal a [[Sentinel-class landing craft|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] in order to evacuate the Gimm sisters and the orphans. However, due to her poor health, Killi decided to remain on Jedha. Kaya and the orphans departed, hoping to find a safer world.<ref name="GotW" /> Killi remained in Jedha City, and was present shortly before its [[Destruction of Jedha City|destruction]] by the Death Star<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> in [[1 BBY]]<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Killi Gimm had light skin, black [[eye]]s<ref name="Manga" /> and short [[hair]] shot through with gray. Her face was lined with worry and her eyes were sunken in to the point of being almost hollow. She wore the red robes of her order, including a hood that covered her head<ref name="GotW" /> and wore a [[metal]]lic [[living sand|sand]] filtering [[Breath mask|respirator mask]] with visor<ref name="ROUVG" /> that covered her face when going outside because of her breathing problems.<ref name="GotW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Killi Gimm was first shown in the reel of promotional footage released for the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' at [[Celebration Europe (2016)|Celebration Europe]] on [[July 15]], [[2016]].<ref name="Celebration">{{SWYouTube|HUb_zpdyDpU|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story - Celebration Reel|sw_url=video/rogue-one-a-star-wars-story-celebration-reel}}</ref> Gimm then went on to appear in the film itself which was released in North America on [[December 15]] later that year. Gimm was not named in the film, but received identification in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'',<ref name="ROUVG" /> which was released the [[December 16|day after the film]].
